Anita turned 58 on 26/06/2016, which was a Tuesday.

Hence, she was born on 26/06/1958.

Number of years in between is 58.

Number of Leap years in between is 1960, 1964, 1968 .. 2016

Hence 15 Leap years in between.

Now every Leap year brings forth 2 days change, and every normal years brings forth 1 day change in the birth day of the week.

Total odd days = Remainder of (58 + 15)/7 = Remainder of 73/7 = 3

Hence Anita's birth day of the week must have been 3 days behind Tuesday, which must have been a Saturday
